items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks with Open Questions
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific Stock: Analyst Estimates & Ratings
items.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific has underperformed the broader market over the past year, yet analysts remain highly bullish about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: PTC Therapeutics Targets Fabry Gene Therapy in $111M Bankruptcy Auction Deal
items.summary: PTC Therapeutics (NASDAQ:PTCT) plans to acquire the ST-920 Fabry disease gene therapy asset through a competitive bankruptcy auction, positioning the company to add a potential one-time treatment to its rare disease portfolio while using its existing global commercial and regulatory infrastructure.

items.title: 3 Profitable Stocks We’re Skeptical Of
items.summary: Even if a company is profitable, it doesn’t always mean it’s a great investment. Some struggle to maintain growth, face looming threats, or fail to reinvest wisely, limiting their future potential.

items.title: Thermo Fisher closes $1.1B sale of microbiology unit to PE firm
items.summary: European private equity firm Astorg will run the business as an independent diagnostics company, led by former PerkinElmer CEO Dirk Bontridder.
